tcp-ip-model-without-trivia.code:
LAYERS = ['DNS', 'ROUTE', 'TLS', 'POLICY', 'HTTP']
HOOKS = {
    'DNS': 'dig +short',
    'ROUTE': 'traceroute -n',
    'TLS': 'openssl s_client -servername',
    'POLICY': 'kubectl describe networkpolicy',
    'HTTP': 'curl -v',
}

INCIDENTS = [
    ('stale-record',
     {'DNS': '10.0.9.30', 'ROUTE': 'reaches',          'TLS': 'verify:0',   'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '200'},
     {'DNS': '10.0.4.9',  'ROUTE': 'dies-at-last-hop', 'TLS': 'no-connect', 'POLICY': 'n/a',   'HTTP': 'timeout'}),
    ('policy-drop',
     {'DNS': '10.0.9.30', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '200'},
     {'DNS': '10.0.9.30', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'deny',  'HTTP': 'timeout'}),
    ('app-bug',
     {'DNS': '10.0.9.30', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '500'},
     {'DNS': '10.0.9.30', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '500'}),
]

def first_divergent_layer(working, failing):
    for layer in LAYERS:
        if working[layer] != failing[layer]:
            return layer, HOOKS[layer]
    return 'NONE', '-'

for name, working, failing in INCIDENTS:
    print(f'== {name} ==')
    suspect, hook = first_divergent_layer(working, failing)
    for layer in LAYERS:
        w, f = working[layer], failing[layer]
        verdict = 'DIVERGES' if w != f else 'ok'
        print(f'{layer:<7} working={w:<10} failing={f:<10} {verdict}')
        if w != f:
            break
    if suspect == 'NONE':
        print('suspect: NONE — path clean on every layer, investigate the application')
    else:
        print(f'suspect: {suspect} — interrogate with: {hook}')

TRACES = [
    ('regional-nxdomain', [
        ('DNS', 'observed', 'fail'), ('ROUTE', 'inferred', 'pass'),
        ('TLS', 'inferred', 'pass'), ('HTTP', 'inferred', 'pass'), ('POLICY', 'inferred', 'pass')]),
    ('cert-trust', [
        ('DNS', 'observed', 'pass'), ('ROUTE', 'observed', 'pass'),
        ('TLS', 'observed', 'fail'), ('HTTP', 'inferred', 'pass'), ('POLICY', 'inferred', 'pass')]),
    ('guessed-policy', [
        ('DNS', 'observed', 'pass'), ('ROUTE', 'observed', 'pass'),
        ('TLS', 'observed', 'pass'), ('HTTP', 'observed', 'pass'), ('POLICY', 'inferred', 'fail')]),
]

def trace_verdict(trace):
    cause, cause_kind = 'NONE', None
    observed = inferred = 0
    for hop, kind, result in trace:
        if kind == 'observed':
            observed += 1
        else:
            inferred += 1
        if result == 'fail' and cause == 'NONE':
            cause, cause_kind = hop, kind
    sound = (cause == 'NONE') or (cause_kind == 'observed')
    return cause, observed, inferred, sound

for name, trace in TRACES:
    cause, obs, inf, sound = trace_verdict(trace)
    print(f'== {name} ==')
    print(f'cause: {cause}  evidence: {obs} observed / {inf} inferred')
    if sound:
        print('verdict: SOUND — the named cause carries direct observation')
    else:
        print('verdict: UNSOUND — cause is inferred, go observe it before the packet ships')

CLIENTS = [
    {'name': 'laptop',  'subnet': 'office/16',    'dns': '10.0.9.30', 'tls': 0, 'reachable': True},
    {'name': 'staging', 'subnet': '10.1.0.0/20',  'dns': '10.0.9.30', 'tls': 0, 'reachable': True},
    {'name': 'prod-a',  'subnet': '10.2.0.0/20',  'dns': '10.0.9.30', 'tls': 0, 'reachable': True},
    {'name': 'prod-b',  'subnet': '10.2.16.0/20', 'dns': '10.0.9.30', 'tls': 0, 'reachable': False},
    {'name': 'prod-c',  'subnet': '10.2.16.0/20', 'dns': '10.0.9.30', 'tls': 0, 'reachable': False},
    {'name': 'prod-d',  'subnet': '10.2.32.0/20', 'dns': '10.0.9.30', 'tls': 0, 'reachable': True},
]

def map_failure_domain(clients):
    for dim in ['dns', 'tls', 'subnet']:
        for v in sorted({str(c[dim]) for c in clients if not c['reachable']}):
            with_v = [c for c in clients if str(c[dim]) == v]
            without_v = [c for c in clients if str(c[dim]) != v]
            if all(not c['reachable'] for c in with_v) and all(c['reachable'] for c in without_v):
                return dim, v, len(with_v)
    return 'NONE', '-', 0

for c in CLIENTS:
    status = 'OK' if c['reachable'] else 'FAIL'
    print(f"{c['name']:<8} subnet={c['subnet']:<13} dns={c['dns']} tls={c['tls']} {status}")

dim, value, blast = map_failure_domain(CLIENTS)
print(f'domain: {dim}={value}')
print(f'blast radius: {blast} client(s)')
print('eliminated: dns, tls — identical across working and failing clients (no partition)')
print(f'kill-test: allow {value} in the policy, re-curl from a failing client, expect 200')

http-semantics.code:
SEMANTICS = {
    'GET':    (True,  True),
    'PUT':    (False, True),
    'DELETE': (False, True),
    'POST':   (False, False),
}

LOG = [
    ('GET',    '/orders/42', False, 'timeout'),
    ('POST',   '/orders',    False, 'timeout'),
    ('POST',   '/orders',    True,  'timeout'),
    ('PUT',    '/cart/7',    False, 'timeout'),
    ('POST',   '/payments',  False, 'ok'),
    ('DELETE', '/cart/7',    False, 'timeout'),
    ('POST',   '/payments',  False, 'timeout'),
]

def may_retry(method, has_key):
    safe, idempotent = SEMANTICS[method]
    return idempotent or has_key

naive_dups = 0
semantic_dups = 0
for method, path, has_key, outcome in LOG:
    if outcome != 'timeout':
        print(f'{method} {path}: ok — no retry needed')
        continue
    _, idempotent = SEMANTICS[method]
    # naive policy: always retry; duplicate iff non-idempotent and no key replay
    if not idempotent and not has_key:
        naive_dups += 1
    if may_retry(method, has_key):
        how = 'idempotent method' if idempotent else 'Idempotency-Key replay'
        print(f'{method} {path}: timeout -> RETRY ({how})')
    else:
        print(f'{method} {path}: timeout -> NO RETRY (non-idempotent, no key) — reconcile via GET')

print(f'naive duplicates: {naive_dups}')
print(f'semantic duplicates: {semantic_dups}')

proxy-and-cdn-path.code:
HOSTNAME = 'cdn.example.com'
CURRENT_ETAG = 'v2-9f31'
EDGES = [
    ('edge-A', 0.48, 'cdn.example.com',    'v2-9f31', 84),
    ('edge-B', 0.31, '*.other-tenant.net', 'v1-77c0', 90210),
    ('edge-C', 0.21, 'cdn.example.com',    'v1-77c0', 46800),
]

def audit_edges():
    cert_pct = 0.0
    stale_pct = 0.0
    healthy_pct = 0.0
    for name, share, cn, etag, age in EDGES:
        cert_bad = cn != HOSTNAME
        cache_bad = etag != CURRENT_ETAG
        cert_s = f'WRONG({cn})' if cert_bad else 'OK'
        cache_s = f'STALE(age {age / 3600:.1f}h)' if cache_bad else 'FRESH'
        print(f'{name}: cert={cert_s} cache={cache_s}')
        if cert_bad:
            cert_pct += share
        if cache_bad:
            stale_pct += share
        if not cert_bad and not cache_bad:
            healthy_pct += share
    print(f'users seeing cert warnings: {cert_pct * 100:.1f}%')
    print(f'users seeing stale content: {stale_pct * 100:.1f}%')
    print(f'users fully healthy: {healthy_pct * 100:.1f}%')

audit_edges()

LAYERS = ['DNS', 'ROUTE', 'TLS', 'POLICY', 'HTTP']

INCIDENTS = [
    ('split-dns',
     {'DNS': '10.0.5.9', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '200'},
     {'DNS': '10.0.4.7', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '200'},
     [('resolver-a-clients', 0.34, 'DNS'), ('resolver-b-clients', 0.16, 'DNS'), ('healthy', 0.50, None)]),
    ('expired-cert',
     {'DNS': '10.0.5.9', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0',  'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '200'},
     {'DNS': '10.0.5.9', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:10', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '200'},
     [('cold-truststore', 0.28, 'TLS'), ('healthy', 0.72, None)]),
    ('app-500s',
     {'DNS': '10.0.5.9', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '500'},
     {'DNS': '10.0.5.9', 'ROUTE': 'reaches', 'TLS': 'verify:0', 'POLICY': 'allow', 'HTTP': '500'},
     [('all', 1.0, None)]),
]

def run_runbook(layers, working, failing, populations):
    lying = next((L for L in layers if working[L] != failing[L]), None)
    stopped = False
    for layer in layers:
        if stopped:
            print(f'  {layer}: not reached')
        elif layer == lying:
            print(f'  {layer}: DIVERGES (working {working[layer]}, failing {failing[layer]})')
            stopped = True
        else:
            print(f'  {layer}: ok')
    if lying is None:
        print('verdict: path clean — investigate the application')
    else:
        blast = sum(share for _, share, layer in populations if layer == lying) * 100
        print(f'verdict: {lying} lying, blast {blast:.1f}%')

for name, working, failing, populations in INCIDENTS:
    print(f'== {name} ==')
    run_runbook(LAYERS, working, failing, populations)
